:::{#exr-zero-matrix-practice}
#### Whether a matrix of zeros is a given zero matrix

A [zero matrix](#def-zero-matrix) carries its shape in its subscript,
because, as @exm-zero-matrix shows,
[zero matrices](#def-zero-matrix) of different shapes are different [matrices](#def-matrix).
Let

$$
\matr{Z} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Is $\matr{Z} = \matr{0}_{2 \times 3}$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compare the shapes of the two [matrices](#def-matrix), using @def-matrix-equality.

:::
